name: Void Boils
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-17: Dreams of a Dustbound Isle
description: Tumor-like growths erupt from the isle as it responds to psychic attack, spewing black lightning and fire in every direction.
disable: DC 26 Occultism check (trained) to reshape the substance of the dream, or DC 30 Performance check (trained) or DC 28 Religion check (trained) to invoke Desna's blessing through hymns or prayers. Each check to disable the hazard is a two-action activity; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine: (1 action) On the hazard's initiative, a boil erupts from the ground and bursts. This blast strikes as many enemies as possible in a 15 foot burst anywhere on the isle, dealing 4d8 force damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save or DC 24 basic Will save, target's choice) to enemies in the area. Aslynn avoids targeting the nightmares with the blast.

offensiveAbilities.name: Awaken
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Sarnia's psychic intrusion begins

Effect The hazard rolls initiative.
